resources.string: Ibona ibyavuzwe mu majwi na videwo byo mu %1$s, ishakisha ry\'Icyongereza ritabasha gusoma. Mu igerageza ryacu ijwi nyaryo ryaje ku mwanya wa mbere %2$d%%, ugereranyije na %3$d%% ritariho.

Isoma ku nshuro ya kabiri imvugo itari iy\'Icyongereza, bityo ayo mafayilo atwara igihe kirekire, kandi ntibitunganijwe ijana ku ijana: tegereza amagambo amwe atari yo. Icyongereza gisomwa nk\'uko bisanzwe. Ururimi rumwe rw\'imvugo icyarimwe; ikenera ububiko bw\'inyongera gusa iyo irimo gukora.
